collection.title: VIIRS/NPP Thermal Anomalies and Fire Daily L3 Global 1km SIN Grid V002
collection.summary: The delivery of all Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership (Suomi NPP) VIIRS science data products [ceased on November 2, 2026 (2026/306)](https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/alerts-outages/reminder-new-suomi-npp-observations-cease-november-2-2026). Data users are encouraged to transition to the equivalent [VJ214A1](https://doi.org/10.5067/VIIRS/VJ214A1.002) (primary) or [VJ114A1](https://doi.org/10.5067/VIIRS/VJ114A1.002) (secondary) data products. The daily NASA/NOAA Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership (Suomi NPP) Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Thermal Anomalies and Fire (VNP14A1) Version 2 data product provides daily information about active fires and other thermal anomalies. The VNP14A1 data product is a global, 1 kilometer (km) gridded composite of fire pixels detected from VIIRS 750 meter (m) bands over a daily (24-hour) period. The VNP14 data products are designed after the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) Thermal Anomalies/Fire product suite. The VNP14A1 product provides a total of four Science Dataset (SDS) layers for the confidence of fire, maximum fire radiative power (FRP), quality assessment (QA), and position of fire within scan. Each data product file is provided in HDF-EOS5 format. A low resolution browse is also provided showing the fire mask layer with a color map applied in JPEG format. Known Issues * For complete information about known issues please refer to the [MODIS/VIIRS Land Quality Assessment website](https://landweb.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/knownissue?sensor=VIIRS).

documentation.description: The LDOPE Land Product Quality Assessment website provides known issues, maneuvers, and product quality of the land products.
The ATBD provides physical theory and mathematical procedures for the calculations used to produce the data products.
The File Specification provides a description of the product file including Scientific Data Sets and their attributes.
The technical information in the User's Guide enables users to interpret and use the data products.
Validation at stage 1 has been achieved for the VIIRS Active Fire product suite.
Further details regarding VIIRS product validation and maturity status are available from VIIRS Land Product Quality Assessment site.
